description: Temaplan overvann Kongsberg kommune – lavpunkt is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kongsberg kommune. Datasettet viser lavpunkt/forsenkninger som ikke har naturlig drenering, der vann vil samle seg om det ikke ligger en stikkrenne eller grunnen naturlig er godt drenert. Lavpunktene er modellert som arealer med ulik vanndybde, opp til over 2.5 m. Datasettet ble produsert i forbindelse med utarbeidelse av temaplan overvann (datert 19.08.2018). Coverage: Kongsberg kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Kongsberg kommune. Its keywords include Samfunnssikkerhet, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, Kongsberg kommune. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, CSV, GPKG, OCTET. The listing shows 2018-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
